comment: Flake quarantine registry. Each entry removes one test from the gating jobs (test-mr-gate, test-linux, nightly-ctest, nightly-asan-ubsan) while nightly-quarantine keeps running it for signal. Fields: test (ctest name), reason (why it flakes / what is being fixed), issue (ticket ref), quarantined (ISO date added), expires (ISO date, suggested +14 days). tools/ci/apply_quarantine.py hard-fails on expired or malformed entries, forcing re-review instead of silent persistence. Workflow: docs/guides/test-matrix.md#quarantine.

entries.reason: TEMPLATE ONLY — ignored by apply_quarantine.py ("example": true). Copy this shape for real entries; never ship an entry without reason/issue/expires.
